scope: ZIP structure and optional exact committed blob comparison only. No Compose/runtime, full-history or legal audit claim. Early candidate may omit final GIF/report; final executable equivalence separate.

checks.name: git ZIP comment equals declared source commit
no dependencies, credentials, cookie state or runtime volumes
no recognized private keys or GitHub tokens
no private coordination, official reference or user report files
complete runtime, lock, CI, license and provenance entrypoints
local demo, ink and original migrations retained
curated provenance has no cachePath or local Windows path
independent Git tree index is bound to declared commit
tree index has unique regular blobs
policy never excludes product, tests, assets or root entrypoints
all expected source files exported, no untracked additions
every exported byte matches exact committed Git blob
